# MiniMEE placement error budget

**Predicted, not measured.** Generated by `python -m metrology.error_budget` from `budget_config.json`. The arm has not been assembled, so every number below comes from datasheets, the hardware docs or a stated assumption. The ISO 9283 test (`metrology/iso9283.py`) on the real arm is what confirms or refutes it.

Targets (hardware_plan_v3, section 9): accuracy < 0.15 mm RMS, repeatability < 0.1 mm std. Errors are evaluated at the worst point on the board, for an 0805.

## Scenarios (each adds to the one above)

| Scenario | Accuracy RMS (mm) | 95% radial (mm) | Repeatability std (mm) | ISO RP (mm) | Meets targets |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| As documented: open loop, nothing calibrated | 5.280 | 9.286 | 0.681 | 1.759 | no / no |
| + camera, kinematic and nozzle calibration | 0.808 | 1.532 | 0.680 | 1.759 | no / no |
| + one-sided approach to every target | 0.415 | 0.780 | 0.036 | 0.115 | no / yes |
| + closed loop on linearized AS5048A at both planar joints | 0.256 | 0.470 | 0.095 | 0.249 | no / yes |
| Hypothetical: + 10:1 reduction on both planar joints *(hypothetical)* | 0.175 | 0.309 | 0.037 | 0.117 | no / yes |

"Meets targets" is accuracy / repeatability. ISO RP = mean distance + 3 std of distance, from the cycle-to-cycle terms only.

**Fix first:**

- **J1 base load deflection (hose drag, friction)** (36%). Measure: Push the nozzle tangentially with a force gauge at standstill and read the angle change; hang the hose and measure its pull. Fix: Closed loop, more hold current, reduction (stiffness grows with ratio squared), lighter hose routing.
- **J2 elbow load deflection (hose drag, friction)** (29%). Measure: Push the nozzle tangentially with a force gauge at standstill and read the angle change; hang the hose and measure its pull. Fix: Closed loop, more hold current, reduction (stiffness grows with ratio squared), lighter hose routing.
- **J1 base stepper position error (+/-5% of a full step)** (9%). Measure: Step through 4 full steps in microsteps and read the real angle (encoder or camera); repeat at a few angles. Fix: Closed loop on a linearized encoder, or reduction.

- **J1 base encoder non-linearity** (27%). Measure: Rotate the joint through its range against a reference (camera on the ChArUco grid, or averaged full-step positions) and log encoder angle vs reference angle. - **J1 base zero offset** (13%). Measure: Kinematic fit (metrology/kinematic_fit.py) estimates it with a standard error. Fix: Kinematic calibration.
- **J2 elbow encoder non-linearity** (13%). Measure: Rotate the joint through its range against a reference (camera on the ChArUco grid, or averaged full-step positions) and log encoder angle vs reference angle. Fix: Per-unit lookup-table linearization in firmware; centre the magnet within the datasheet limits.

## Board distance from the base

Scenario: + closed loop on linearized AS5048A at both planar joints. The board is moved along its current direction from the base. J1's error at the nozzle grows with distance from the base; J2's and the cameras' don't.

| Board centre radius (mm) | Accuracy RMS (mm) |
| --- | --- |
| 100 | 0.200 |
| 130 | 0.211 |
| 160 | 0.223 |
| 190 | 0.237 |
| 220 | 0.251 |
| 250 | 0.267 |
| 280 | 0.283 |

## Assumptions to replace with measurements

Edit these in the config once measured, and change each source to say how.

| Input | Value | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `geometry.elbow` | 1 | assumed: elbow bends counter-clockwise (theta2 > 0) |
| `approach` | "bidirectional" | assumed: firmware doesn't yet approach every target from the same side |
| `unidirectional_residual_frac` | 0.2 | assumed: share of a direction-dependent error left after one-sided approach plus calibration |
| `joints.j1.microsteps` | 16 | assumed TMC2209 setting |
| `joints.j1.holding_torque_nm` | 0.4 | assumed typical 40 mm NEMA 17: read your motor's datasheet |
| `joints.j1.load_torque_nm` | 0.02 | assumed: vacuum hose and wiring drag plus bearing friction. Measure it |
| `joints.j1.backlash_deg` | 0.1 | assumed with the spring anti-backlash nuts; the hardware doc's figure without them is 0.3 deg |
| `joints.j1.zero_uncertainty_deg` | 1.0 | assumed: where the joint really is at commanded zero, before calibration |
| `joints.j1.homing_repeatability_deg` | 0.05 | assumed limit switch; not used when an absolute encoder sets zero |
| `joints.j1.encoder.closed_loop` | false | assumed: no closed-loop firmware yet |
| `joints.j2.full_steps_per_rev` | 200 | assumed 1.8 deg NEMA 14 (hardware doc names NEMA 14, not its step angle) |
| `joints.j2.microsteps` | 16 | assumed TMC2209 setting |
| `joints.j2.holding_torque_nm` | 0.15 | assumed typical NEMA 14: read your motor's datasheet |
| `joints.j2.load_torque_nm` | 0.01 | assumed: hose drag at the wrist. Measure it |
| `joints.j2.backlash_deg` | 0.1 | assumed with the spring anti-backlash nuts; the hardware doc's figure without them is 0.3 deg |
| `joints.j2.zero_uncertainty_deg` | 1.0 | assumed: where the joint really is at commanded zero, before calibration |
| `joints.j2.homing_repeatability_deg` | 0.05 | assumed limit switch at the elbow |
| `links.length_tolerance_mm` | 0.3 | assumed: tube cut length plus printed socket depth |
| `links.lateral_load_n` | 0.1 | assumed: hose side load at the wrist |
| `links.tube_wall_mm` | 1.0 | assumed wall thickness |
| `links.tube_modulus_gpa` | 70.0 | assumed, conservative for pultruded carbon tube |
| `links.printed_joint_compliance_mm` | 0.02 | assumed tip deflection from the PETG joints under the same load |
| `links.printed_length_mm` | 60.0 | assumed total PETG length in the chain |
| `links.temperature_swing_k` | 5.0 | assumed: room drift plus motor heating |
| `registration.base_offset_uncertainty_mm` | 5.0 | assumed: the (190, 40) placeholder has never been measured |
| `camera_top.px_per_mm` | 12.8 | assumed: 720p camera (hardware doc) seeing a 100 mm wide field |
